jobs_results.title: Senior PHP Developer
jobs_results.description:
Description

Coniq is a dynamic, high growth UK-based SaaS company that provides total customer engagement and loyalty services to many of the world’s leading property developers, shopping centres and retailers. Coniq powers well over £1 billion of sales annually for its clients, with more than 20 million consumers shopping at 1,800 brands in 24 countries worldwide, and has offices in Europe, the US and the Middle East.

We’re looking for PHP Developers to join our international team. This is a hybrid role based in Barcelona, Spain, however, we're considering candidates nationwide.

You will be working closely with the Product Manager to provide our clients with a solid, robust and modern product. You are also expected to provide assistance to less senior team mates, do code reviews and ensure code standards are being followed.

Responsibilities
• Refactor existing code to improve performance, readability, maintainability, and scalability
• Take a lead role in projects, setting the... technical direction and supervising the work of other developers
• Develop new features and maintain the server-side web-based applications
• Contribute to the design of new features of the platform
• Help triage and fix software defects
• Take a lead role in promoting high quality, standards compliant code in an efficient Agile process, by contributing critical code-review feedback and representing and challenging our application of Agile principles

Requirements
• Minimum 3 years of commercial experience
• 2 years of commercial experience with Symfony framework
• Professional experience with developing server-side web based applications
• SOLID experience with Object-oriented and various Design Patterns
• Strong knowledge and experience of working in an Agile environment
• Experience of code-review and peer-feedback processes
• Experience in designing and consuming RESTful APIs
• Proficiency with git
• Experience with distributed applications and event driven systems

The following will make you stand out as a candidate:
• Experience with Docker
• Expertise with deploying code using multiple programming languages
• Familiarity with AWS Tooling
• Experience with TDD
• Experience with DDD
• Experience in refactoring monolithic applications into SOA

Benefits

We offer a generous package, including:
• Competitive salary
• Company stock options
• 25 days holiday plus statutory holidays
• A day off to celebrate your birthday
• A day off for your wellbeing
• Shorter working hours on Fridays
• A strong company values framework, including paid leave for volunteering with approved charities
• Regular team building activities
• Training & development allowance
• New employee referral scheme

This is a unique opportunity to join a VC-funded high growth SaaS business where we all share a passion to work together to build a great product and a great company. We are proud of our company culture and invest a great deal into making sure that we promote Diversity in the workplace. Together we come from over 20 nationalities and as a tech business, we are very proud of the 50/50 gender split.

Apply for this job

jobs_results.title: SENIOR PHP BACKEND DEVELOPER
jobs_results.description:
In Kimia we keep growing!

We are looking for a skilled and passionate Senior PHP Backend Developer to become part of our backend tech team at AscendAd.

AscendAd is an AdTech company focused on simplifying and optimizing mobile advertising. We are developing also a new business direct to consumer and a completely new architecture and platform.

Role description:
• Work on high-scalable PHP8+ Laravel 10+ microservice High-performance PHP backend process as a service.
• Development of APIs.
• Integration of multiple external APIs.
• Work closely with co-workers from different locations (Madrid, Tel-Aviv, Agios Dometios, Tbilisi).

REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS:
• Proficiency in PHP7+, MySQL. (Minimum experience of 4 years in PHP).
• Recent experience with MVC frameworks (Laravel, Symfony, Zend or Yii2).
• Familiarity with Linux environments, Unit Testing (PHPUnit).
• Ability to make and take responsibility for high level technical decisions.
• You speak English fluently (at least C1).

Bonus ... Extra points!:
• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Git, Ci/Cd, AWS (ElasticCache, S3, Redshift, ...), PostgreSQL, APIs integration experience, RESTful APIs or tasks managers, microservice architecture patterns, is a plus.
• BS Computer Science or equivalent is a plus.

What's in it for you?:
• A place where your impact counts!
• A young & dynamic working environment with very good working atmosphere.
• Great localization! Kimia’s HQs are in Madrid’s heart.
• Short working Fridays
